schema.title: Configure registration (step 3)
schema.description: Sets the event registration: its title, whether it is open, the venue and room, the capacity, the pricing with its ticket, and the contact.

operation.label: Configure registration (step 3)
operation.description: Sets the event registration: its title, whether it is open, the venue and room, the capacity, the pricing with its ticket, and the contact.

capacity.description: Up to 400 for the Main hall.
Up to 120 for the East room.
Up to 60 for the Reading room.
Up to 30 for the Garden room.
Up to 150 for the Upper deck.
Up to 100 without an event license.

note.title: Note
note.description: Shown beside the register button, for example "Donations welcome".

x-surface.patternMessage: A license number is four digits, such as 2048.

event.license.title: event.license
event.license.description: The four digits after EV- on the license, such as 2048. Required to host more than 100 people.

x-surface.patternMessage: A license number is four digits, such as 2048.
